newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Ofer Brothers weigh India power projects.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Ofer Brothers weigh India power projects.

text.p: Israel's Ofer Brothers Investments Ltd are considering investing in private power projects in India, Moshe Katz, managing director of Energy Horizons, a consulting firm owned by Ofer Brothers, said.

"We are looking into a number of power plant projects which would use either coal or other fuels," Katz told Reuters. He said that a decision on whether to invest in private power in India would be taken within the next few months.
India is considered one of the most attractive markets for private power projects due to the huge potential.
Ofer Brothers is a privately-held company with interests in shipping, real estate, banking and industry.
